question: Re-measured on an ISOLATED G17P, does EXP-0158's 233-of-237 zero-copied synthesis result survive, and does its pre-registered cross-run byte-identity gate pass?
independent_variable: concurrent GPU load on the target (contended in EXP-0158, isolated here)
controlled_variables: the 289 generated programs, proven byte-identical to EXP-0158's
synth.py / generator.py / families.py / cf.py / casematrix.py / frozen_pilot.py
case order, poisoned 0xDEADBEEF read-back buffer, integrity sentinel
one fresh process per case, 5-retry InnocentVictim policy
cascade witness every 40 cases, majority-of-3 revalidation pass

M1_STRICT_PAIR.definition: cases with zero COPIED provenance fields and expect_match=true whose match==true in BOTH gated runs, no revalidation credit

M3_ATTRIBUTABLE.definition: analysis/summarize.py HEADLINE_ATTRIBUTABLE_N: produced its exact oracle at least once and NEVER a wrong value / silent zero / no-write

M4_CROSS_RUN_GATE.definition: verify.py --captured: 01_results.jsonl byte-identical across the two gated runs

pre_committed_conclusions.if_M3_below_225: EXP-0158's 233 was contamination-inflated; this experiment's number becomes the defensible figure for DRV-ISA-01 / P0.6. Reported as the headline. Every program whose verdict changed is named individually. No post-hoc metric may be introduced to recover a larger figure.
pre_committed_conclusions.if_M1_below_200_with_quiet_sampler: Contention was NOT the explanation for EXP-0158's failing gate; the nondeterminism is a property of this corpus or harness. Reported as the headline, evidenced by fault-class strings plus the sampler record.
pre_committed_conclusions.if_sampler_max_foreign_nonzero: The isolation claim is WITHDRAWN and the run is reported as a second contaminated run, worth nothing.

singled_out.dag_040_n20: ok in EXP-0158 run03, victim in run04, fault 5/5 in its witness-gated reconfirm; counted inside the 233 on one ok

isolation.reason_no_lock: ~/agxre/gpulease.sh is a neutralised pass-through shim as of 2026-08-30 and takes no lock; EXP-0158's own run03/run04 went through the same shim. Orchestrator decision 2026-08-30: do not build a new lock.
isolation.mechanism: orchestrator quiesced the other device agents (EXP-0163, EXP-0165, EXP-0166); verified empirically by this experiment's own sampler

sampler.matches: agxrun|agxrun_persist|shdump|agxtest|agxparse|persistrun|MTLReplayer, plus any python process whose args name an EXP-NNNN path
sampler.mtlcompiler_service: counted separately with %cpu; idle XPC instances are normal and are NOT counted as contention
sampler.precondition: a >= 3-minute pre-window baseline with n_foreign == 0 before any device operation

run_ids.burned_ids_policy: a defective capture is RETAINED and flagged; a replacement takes a NEW id

raw_schema.raw/<run-id>/00_env.json: target identity, authored/kernel/doc/pinned hashes, frozen pilot id, boundary statement
raw_schema.raw/<run-id>/01_results.jsonl: one gated record per case: name, group, carrier, oracle, oracle_bits, expect_match, notes, prov, status, fault_class, pipeline_source, out_hex, observed, word_outcomes, outcome, sentinel, match, victim_retries
raw_schema.raw/<run-id>/01_timing.jsonl: per-case duration and subprocess stdio (NOT gated for byte-identity)
raw_schema.raw/<run-id>/04_revalidate.jsonl: majority-of-3 re-runs of every fault/hang/victim/invalid_run/missing case
raw_schema.raw/isolation/*.jsonl: concurrency samples, one JSON object per 2 s

stop_conditions: any FOREIGN harness process sampled during a gated run -> retain the run, flag it contaminated, do not use it for M1-M4, replacement takes a NEW run id
two genuine hangs outside the known-fault cases -> stop that arm, report PARTIAL
target stops answering -> STOP and report BLOCKED; no macvdmtool, no scanning
pre-capture smoke defect -> pre-capture stop, raw/ never created
known_confounders: C1 self-inflicted contamination: our own deliberate fault cases (regb_R126_faultarm, regb_R127_faultarm, adv_iadd_dst_reg96, iaddsyn r0) can reset the device and make OUR OWN next case an InnocentVictim, breaking byte-identity even under perfect isolation. Leading alternative explanation if H4 fails.
C2 a neighbouring context's hang: EXP-0163 hit a real kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorHang at ~00:42 from `iter_at` grp=0x50, ~7 hours before this window.

C3 oracle-value ambiguity: classify_word tests got==expected before the zero test, so a case whose oracle is exactly 0.0 cannot separate 'computed 0' from 'silently zeroed'. 3 of the 237 have an entirely-zero oracle. Inherited from EXP-0158 by design.
C4 thermal/DVFS state: not controlled, recorded only via load average.
out_of_scope: closing the 24 donor-dependent cases (12 CF, 12 immediate-mode iadd2) -- separate optional arm only, never traded against the confirmation
revisiting EXP-0158's ld_format / iadd2.srcA / falu2.mod_hi corrections
editing docs/, PROVENANCE.md, tools/, or anything under EXP-0158-*

clean_room.boundary: public Metal API only; runtime MSL compile of our own carrier kernels; binary-archive splice of our own GENERATED AGX programs; owned shared buffers; every case a fresh process; /bin/ps and sysctl for machine state; no Apple binary, archive, BO, or command-stream inspection beyond our own compiled/generated bytes
